name: solvency_price_geq_1
informal: totalAssets >= totalShares after any deposit with fee and floor-division share minting: the vault exchange rate never drops below 1. Proved by decomposing newAssets - newShares into three non-negative summands (price surplus, fee, rounding gap) and leveraging Solidity 0.8 underflow checks.
notes: Two functions: non-empty vault deposit and initial deposit. All assertions proved safe by CHC/z3. Vacuity confirmed via mutated strict-inequality counterexample. Overflow bounds (1e30) used as sound assume-abstraction.

name: fee_backing
informal: accruedFees <= totalAssets — the fee accumulator never exceeds total vault assets. Proved for deposit (fee accrual), initial deposit, and fee withdrawal paths.
notes: Three functions covering deposit, initial deposit, and fee withdrawal. All 3 assertions proved safe by CHC/z3. Vacuity confirmed via flipped-direction counterexample. Overflow bounds (1e30) used as sound assume-abstraction.

name: share_price_monotone
informal: Shares minted per deposit never exceed the proportional share entitlement (no dilution via rounding). Formally: sharesToMint * totalAssets <= netDeposit * totalShares, which follows directly from floor-division semantics.
notes: Single function. Assertion proved safe by CHC/z3. Vacuity confirmed via mutated strict-inequality counterexample at equality point (1:1:1:0). Overflow bounds (1e30) used as sound assume-abstraction.
